description: This file defines an extension method for IServiceProvider to create a child container by cloning and selectively including services from an existing IServiceCollection, with special handling for singleton and disposable services.

classes.name: ServiceProviderExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for IServiceProvider, specifically for creating child containers.

methods.name: CreateChildContainer
methods.description: Creates a new IServiceCollection (child container) by cloning services from an existing collection, with logic to handle singleton, disposable, and generic services.
